mappings.applicability_reason: The admin console is an administrative interface whose reach over customer data is documented, so the requirement's stronger-access-path expectation applies.
assumptions: No common false positive applies: the console's access path is documented as the same SSO accounts and same sign-in path customers use, which is not a stronger path — the conclusion rests on that statement, not on an absent role-based permission matrix or absent operator-onboarding description, which the catalog names as false positives.
